candidate.definition_en: The protruding part of the face below the mouth.
candidate.explanation_ar: منطقة الدقن اللي في وشك تحت بوقك.

senses.definition_en: The protruding part of the face below the mouth.
senses.explanation_ar: الجزء السفلي من الوجه أسفل الفم (الذقن).
examples: She rested her chin on her hand.
He rubbed the stubble on his chin.
The boxer took a heavy blow to the chin.
